description: Angular component for editing JSON objects with Ace editor integration, including validation, formatting, and error handling.

classes.name: JsonObjectEditComponent
classes.description: Angular component providing a JSON object editor with validation, formatting, and error notifications.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes Ace editor with configuration and sets up resize observer.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer and destroys Ace editor instance.

methods.name: onAceEditorResize
methods.description: Handles resizing of Ace editor on container resize.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the disabled state of the editor.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the JSON object, returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: validateOnSubmit
methods.description: Performs validation and shows error notification if invalid.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the component's value and updates the editor content.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates internal model based on editor content and performs validation.

methods.name: onFullscreen
methods.description: Resizes the editor for fullscreen mode.
